account: It is ten o'clock on day 0, and I am in the plaza for my scheduled market walk. This morning the secretary said no correspondence or urgent business had reached her. She initially thought the appointments chest was empty, but I had returned the book, and I saw her take it after I confirmed today's schedule. She has now arrived in the plaza. Townsfolk 10 and 30 both reported that the baker was carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery; that sounds consistent with baking supplies, not evidence of trouble. The one unusual incident I heard was the builder shouting, 'Freight, please wait! I need a private word.' Freight later shouted something, but I could not make out the words. I do not know what their business concerns or whether it is important to the town. I have asked Townsfolk 20 how market trade is going and whether any town matters need attention, but have not yet heard an answer. So far I have no confirmed urgent problem.
